candidates.meaning: Show the distinct wine regions and the types of tours they offer.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT WRT.WineRegionID, WT.Type FROM Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours WRT JOIN Winery_Tours WT ON WRT.TourType = WT.Type

candidates.meaning: List all tours available in each wine region, including duplicates if any.
candidates.sql: SELECT WRT.WineRegionID, WT.Type FROM Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours WRT JOIN Winery_Tours WT ON WRT.TourType = WT.Type

candidates.meaning: Display the wine regions along with the specific tour types they offer, ensuring each region is listed once with all its tour types.
candidates.sql: SELECT WRT.WineRegionID, GROUP_CONCAT(WT.Type) AS TourTypes FROM Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours WRT JOIN Winery_Tours WT ON WRT.TourType = WT.Type GROUP BY WRT.WineRegionID
